item.name: DESSINI ITALY CLIPEASE 10 PCS Detachable Handle Induction Casserole Pot Non Stick Frying Pan Wok Bowl Cookware PERIUK
item.title: DESSINI ITALY CLIPEASE 10 PCS Detachable Handle Induction Casserole Pot Non Stick Frying Pan Wok Bowl Cookware PERIUK
item.description:
Product Description:

- DESSINI CLIPEASE Series 10 PCS Detachable Handle Cookware Set
- Model: CES-10-S
- Dual-purpose design: Cook meals in the same cookware and serve them straight to the table, eliminating the need for extra serving dishes.
- Detachable handle allows you to easily transition from cooking to serving, functioning as both cookware and a serving plate.
- Removable handles for easy storage and space-saving.
- Securely locks into place during cooking and removes with a simple press
- Stay cool handles design to ensure safe cooking and prevent user scalding during cooking time
- Material: Super-conductive die-cast aluminium
- Adopts with non-stick coating, no worry about pieces of meat sticking on the pan, makes cleaning extremely easy.
- High resistance to scratches and excellent durability
- Non-stick exterior coating easy cleaning and convenient cooking
- Heat resistant exterior, safely used in dishwasher
- Able use with different cooktops such as induction cookers, electric, ceramic, or your traditional gas range.
- Diffusion base enhances energy saving
- Distribute heat evenly and quickly resulting in faster and more uniform cooking to get perfectly grilled meat every single time
- Saving power and keeping food warm for longer.
- Low consumption of oil.
- Give your kitchen a makeover with this stylish and sleek cookware set.


Important Safety Note ⚠️

- Do not place the handle near open flame, hot stovetop, or direct heat while cooking.


Packaging Included: (FULLSET)

- 1 x 18CM Pot ( CES-P18 )
- 1 x 20CM Pot ( CES-P20 )
- 1 x 26CM Pot ( CES-P26 )
- 1 x 26CM Cover ( SGL-26 )
- 1 x Detachable Handle ( DH-01 )
- 1 x 20CM Seal Lid ( Suitable for 18cm pot )
- 1 x 18CM Fry Basket
- 2 x 40CM Protector Pad
- 1 x 30CM Protector Pad
